name: Example feature
description: A worked feature.manifest.json — copy, rename, and keep every field honest (CPR v1.1 Appendix B).

permissions.grants: create, edit and archive example items

notableColumns.why: deletes archive; rows are never erased (rule R-00x)

installActions: grant example-feature.items.manage to the roles that manage items
uninstallActions: disable the feature; do NOT drop example_items — data retention is a separate, explicit decision
